name: MonarchColumnMapping
title: ColumnMapping
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.lazy.LazyColumn of rows, each with a MonarchSelect (androidx.compose.material3.ExposedDropdownMenuBox) per column; MonarchBadge for suggestions, MonarchButton for the bulk actions
summary: The mapping step of an import: one picker per imported column with example values, suggested fields from names and aliases, and the required fields still unmapped and the fields chosen twice.
whenToUse: After someone picks a CSV or spreadsheet to import, on its own screen, to choose which product field each column fills.
whenNotToUse: To choose which columns a table shows, use MonarchColumnChooser. To preview the rows that will be imported, use MonarchPreviewRows.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchColumnMapping(sources: List<MonarchColumnMappingSource>, mapping: Map<String, String>, fields: List<MonarchColumnMappingField>, onMappingChange: (Map<String, String>) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, suggestions: Map<String, MonarchColumnMappingSuggestion>? = null, showIssues: Boolean = true, showBulkActions: Boolean = true, enabled: Boolean = true, state: LazyListState = rememberLazyListState(), contentPadding: PaddingValues = PaddingValues(), labels: MonarchColumnMappingLabels = MonarchColumnMappingLabels())
public data class MonarchColumnMappingSource(name: String, samples: List<String> = emptyList())
public data class MonarchColumnMappingField(id: String, label: String, required: Boolean = false, description: String? = null, aliases: List<String> = emptyList())
public data class MonarchColumnMappingSuggestion(fieldId: String, confidence: MonarchColumnMappingConfidence, score: Double)
public enum class MonarchColumnMappingConfidence { Exact, Similar }
public data class MonarchColumnMappingIssues(missing: List<MonarchColumnMappingField>, duplicates: Map<String, List<String>>) { val isEmpty: Boolean }

public object MonarchColumnMappingDefaults { const val DEFAULT_THRESHOLD: Double = 0.75; fun suggest(sources: List<MonarchColumnMappingSource>, fields: List<MonarchColumnMappingField>, threshold: Double = DEFAULT_THRESHOLD): Map<String, MonarchColumnMappingSuggestion>; fun mapping(suggestions: Map<String, MonarchColumnMappingSuggestion>): Map<String, String>; fun issues(mapping: Map<String, String>, fields: List<MonarchColumnMappingField>): MonarchColumnMappingIssues }

public class MonarchColumnMappingLabels(label: String? = null, fieldFor: ((String) -> String)? = null, skip: String? = null, required: String? = null, exactMatch: String? = null, suggested: String? = null, noSamples: String? = null, summary: ((Int, Int) -> String)? = null, missing: ((String) -> String)? = null, duplicate: ((String, String) -> String)? = null, useSuggestions: String? = null, skipAll: String? = null, position: ((Int) -> String)? = null)

options.name: sources
options.description: The columns of the imported data in file order: the header and a few example values.

options.name: mapping
options.description: Column name to field id. A column missing from it is not imported. Start from MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.mapping(MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.suggest(sources, fields)).

options.name: fields
options.description: The fields the columns can be mapped to, with required flags, help and aliases.

options.name: onMappingChange
options.description: Called with the whole new mapping when a picker or a bulk action changes it.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the list. Give it a bounded height inside scrolling content.

options.name: suggestions
options.description: The suggestions behind the badges and Use suggestions. By default, MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.suggest(sources, fields).

options.name: showIssues
options.description: Shows the missing required fields and the duplicate errors. Pass false until the person first tries to go on.

options.name: showBulkActions
options.description: Shows Use suggestions (when the mapping differs from them) and Don’t import any (when something is mapped).

options.name: enabled
options.description: Whether the pickers and the bulk buttons can be used.

options.name: state
options.description: The scroll state of the list.

options.name: contentPadding
options.description: The padding around the rows, inside the scrolling area, for example for a bottom bar.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for every built-in string: picker labels, the skip option, badges, the summary, the errors, the buttons and the name of a blank header.

states.name: suggested
states.description: A column set to its suggested field shows a success "Matched" badge for an exact match or an info "Suggested" badge for a close one.

states.name: not imported
states.description: The picker shows "Don’t import"; the column is missing from the mapping.

states.name: missing required
states.description: Under the count, "Map a column to: …" in the strong danger color on the danger subtle fill with the danger border.

states.name: duplicate
states.description: Each column that chose the same field shows its picker in the error state with "<Field> is also chosen for <other columns>." under it.

states.name: disabled
states.description: With enabled = false, the pickers and the bulk buttons cannot be used and take their disabled colors.

appearance: A list of rows separated by subtle dividers. Column headers in the default text color and strong weight, example values, the count and help in the muted text color; the pickers are MonarchSelect outlined fields with the input border. Errors use the danger roles and are always words. The roles follow light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ColumnMapping is a three-column grid (column, example values, field) with a native select per row and column headings on wide screens. On a phone a three-column grid does not fit, so, as on iOS, each column is a list row with its header and example values above the picker, and the headings are left out. The picker is MonarchSelect, a Material 3 exposed dropdown menu whose visible label is "Field for <column>"; a field's help also shows as the option's description in the menu. The list is a LazyColumn that scrolls itself, like the iOS List, so give it its own screen or a bounded height; state and contentPadding are offered for that. The web size prop (sm, md) has no counterpart: rows size themselves with the font size setting. The web value and onValueChange become mapping and onMappingChange; the web's uncontrolled defaultValue is the app's initial state. The suggestion algorithm (normalising names, word overlap, containment and edit distance, threshold 0.75, each field once) is the same as the web's suggestColumnMapping; the web's toFieldMapping is not offered (mapping.entries.associate { it.value to it.key } gives it). iOS names showsIssues and showsBulkActions and has static functions on the view; Android uses the Compose style showIssues and showBulkActions, and the functions live on MonarchColumnMappingDefaults. MonarchColumnMappingLabels adds position, the name of a blank header, so every built-in string can be replaced.
accessibility: The list is a group named "Column mapping".
Each column's header and example values are one element, read before its picker.
Each picker is labelled "Field for <column>" and reads its value, the chosen field or "Don’t import"; a duplicate is the field's error, read with it.
The missing-fields message is an error and a polite live region; errors are words in the danger colors, never color alone; suggestions are a word in a badge, not only a tone.
The count ("3 of 5 columns mapped") is a polite live region, so changes are announced.
The pickers are at least 56dp high and the bulk buttons have 48dp touch targets.
edgeCases: A blank header is shown as its position, "#3".
Two columns with the same header share one entry in the mapping, because the mapping is keyed by name, as on the web.
A field id in the mapping that is not in fields does not count as mapped, and its picker shows "Don’t import".
Long headers and values wrap; nothing is truncated.
Only the first three example values that are not blank are shown.

examples.title: Contacts import
examples.template:
MonarchColumnMapping(
    sources = sources,
    mapping = mapping,
    fields = fields,
    onMappingChange = { mapping = it },
    // The list scrolls itself: give it its own screen or a bounded height.
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(1300.dp),
)
examples.setupTemplate:
val sources = listOf(
    MonarchColumnMappingSource({{sources.0.name}}, listOf({{sources.0.samples.0}}, {{sources.0.samples.1}})),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource({{sources.1.name}}, listOf({{sources.1.samples.0}}, {{sources.1.samples.1}})),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource({{sources.2.name}}, listOf({{sources.2.samples.0}})),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource({{sources.3.name}}, listOf({{sources.3.samples.0}})),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource({{sources.4.name}}),
)
val fields = listOf(
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = {{fields.0.id}}, label = {{fields.0.label}}, required = {{fields.0.required}}),
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = {{fields.1.id}}, label = {{fields.1.label}}, required = {{fields.1.required}}, aliases = listOf({{fields.1.aliases.0}}, {{fields.1.aliases.1}})),
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = {{fields.2.id}}, label = {{fields.2.label}}, description = {{fields.2.description}}),
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = {{fields.3.id}}, label = {{fields.3.label}}),
)
var mapping by remember {
    mutableStateOf(MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.mapping(MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.suggest(sources, fields)))
}
examples.setup:
val sources = listOf(
    MonarchColumnMappingSource("Full Name", listOf("Sam Lee", "Ana Ruiz")),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource("E-mail", listOf("sam@example.com", "ana@example.org")),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource("Phone", listOf("+44 20 7946 0000")),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource("Organisation name", listOf("Example Ltd")),
    MonarchColumnMappingSource("Notes"),
)
val fields = listOf(
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = "name", label = "Name", required = true),
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = "email", label = "Email", required = true, aliases = listOf("E-mail", "Mail")),
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = "phone", label = "Phone number", description = "International format, e.g. +44 20 7946 0000"),
    MonarchColumnMappingField(id = "company", label = "Company"),
)
var mapping by remember {
    mutableStateOf(MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.mapping(MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.suggest(sources, fields)))
}
examples.code:
MonarchColumnMapping(
    sources = sources,
    mapping = mapping,
    fields = fields,
    onMappingChange = { mapping = it },
    // The list scrolls itself: give it its own screen or a bounded height.
    modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(1300.dp),
)

examples.title: Checking the mapping before going on
examples.code:
Column {
    MonarchColumnMapping(
        sources = listOf(MonarchColumnMappingSource("Mail"), MonarchColumnMappingSource("E-mail")),
        mapping = mapping,
        fields = fields,
        onMappingChange = { mapping = it },
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().height(360.dp),
        showIssues = showIssues,
    )
    MonarchButton(
        text = "Next",
        onClick = { showIssues = !MonarchColumnMappingDefaults.issues(mapping, fields).isEmpty },
        variant = MonarchButtonVariant.Primary,
    )
}
